objective: Make operator and agent release instructions agree on one resumable release sequence and every configured target's result.
acceptanceCriteria:
All phases and target receipts identify the same reviewed source SHA; promotion cannot precede observed reviewed merge.
Missing/empty registry, failed target, unsafe local path or dirty/diverged/mismatched runtime stops with exact blocker and no overwrite.
Repeated release with matching VERSION still reconciles explicit targets using tested promoted source.
Every Factory operation has a workflow command owner; skill prompts contain no script-running instructions.
nonGoals: No host checkout hand edits, target discovery, service-specific infrastructure rollout or GitHub setting changes.
risks: risk:high: Release workflow command steps own executable operations; skills describe inputs, artifact review and blockers. PR preparation/independent review happens before promotion and cannot be reordered by finish instructions. Consume promotion SHA receipt, snapshot only the explicit target registry, classify shared versus legacy full-install entries, and validate absolute local projectPath before legacy writes. Shared targets receive promoted mounted content and automation reconciliation; legacy targets get supported dry-run/full-install flows. Never sync unmerged working-tree automation definitions ahead of the promoted SHA. Use per-phase and per-target receipts keyed by source SHA and registry snapshot digest. A retry reruns incomplete targets without hiding a failed target or skipping required reconciliation at unchanged VERSION. Preserve the original contributor command-ownership and remote-checkout refusal rules; do not edit AGENTS.md to exempt release scripts.
suggestedWorkBreakdown:
Introduce/extend command-owned release workflow with validation, merged-SHA selection, promotion, sync and runtime parity steps.
Make push/sync procedures consume the promoted source checkout and emit target receipts; enforce dry-run for full-layer targets.
Rewrite both release skills around those artifacts, repair the malformed promotion path and eliminate duplicate/contradictory procedure text.
Test interrupted phases, partial-target failure, absent registry, shared/legacy entries and dirty/mismatched host receipts.
unresolvedQuestions: Awaiting explicit human approval of the recorded high-risk plan.
